简单取放.title: Two-step simple pick-and-place plan
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place goals, decompose the task into exactly two ordered subtasks: (S1) find and take the target object, then (S2) put the target object at the specified destination.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the goal is a simple pick-and-place instruction such as 'put a/an/some <object> in/on <destination>' and no additional state change (cleaning, heating, cooling, etc.) is required.

简单取放.title: Avoid exhaustive closed-container search before checking open surfaces
简单取放.description: In failed simple pick-and-place episodes, the planner often searched many closed drawers or cabinets before checking open surfaces where the target object was actually visible. This wastes steps and can lead to plan failure when the object is on an open surface.
简单取放.why_it_happens: The initial plan treats 'find the object' as an unconstrained search and does not prioritize open, directly observable locations over closed containers.
简单取放.how_to_avoid: When locating the target object, first inspect open surfaces and visible locations (tables, dressers, shelves, countertops, sofas, beds, etc.) before opening closed containers. Only open closed containers if the object is not found on any open surface.

简单取放.title: Do not assume target object is absent after failed take attempts
简单取放.description: In failed episodes, the planner repeatedly attempted to take the target object from locations where it was not present, and sometimes concluded the object was unavailable without systematically checking all plausible open surfaces. This led to plan failure even though the object may have been present elsewhere.
简单取放.why_it_happens: The search strategy does not maintain a systematic list of candidate locations and may prematurely stop or repeat failed locations.
简单取放.how_to_avoid: After a failed take attempt, mark that location as checked and move to a new unchecked plausible location. Continue until all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked before declaring the object unavailable.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：先定位并点亮台灯，再取目标物
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，先找到并打开 desklamp，再获取待观察物体，最后执行 examine/look。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 目标为 examine/look at X under/with the desklamp，且环境中存在可用的 desklamp。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要先取台灯，除非确认可携带且目标物已就位
台灯观察.description: 多个失败轨迹显示，计划先 take desklamp 会导致后续 take/examine 失败或无法完成观察。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: desklamp 可能不可携带或需要留在原位作为观察光源；先取台灯会破坏后续 examine/look 条件。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 优先在目标物所在位置附近寻找并打开 desklamp；若必须移动目标物，则将目标物带到台灯处，而不是先取走台灯。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：目标物不在初始位置时，先搜索容器再规划取物
台灯观察.description: 多个失败轨迹在未找到目标物时反复开关抽屉或盲目移动，导致 plan_failed。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 目标物可能位于抽屉、柜子等容器中；未系统搜索就尝试取物会失败。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 先按容器类型（drawer/cabinet）系统搜索目标物，找到后再执行 take 和 examine/look。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要用 put 代替 examine/look
台灯观察.description: 部分轨迹将目标物放到 desk 或 desklamp 上，但未执行 examine/look，导致 plan_completed_without_environment_win。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 任务目标是观察，不是放置；put 动作不会触发观察成功条件。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 在目标物与 desklamp 同处后，必须执行 examine X 或 look at X under the desklamp。

清洗后放置.title: 清洗后放置标准三步计划
清洗后放置.principle: 对于“清洗后放置”任务，初始计划应分解为三个有序子任务：S1 找到并拿起目标物品；S2 在 sinkbasin 清洗该物品；S3 将清洗后的物品放到目标容器或表面。
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: 当目标为“put a clean X in/on Y”或“clean some X and put it in/on Y”时。

清洗后放置.title: 清洗前必须确认物品可清洗
清洗后放置.description: 部分物品（如 towel、cloth）在 sinkbasin 上执行 clean 动作时不会成功，导致计划失败。
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: 环境中并非所有物品都支持 clean 动作，或目标物品可能不是任务要求的可清洗物品。
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: 在制定计划时，优先选择常见可清洗物品（如 cup、bowl、plate、knife、pot、pan、kettle、soapbar、lettuce、tomato、potato、egg、dishsponge、ladle、mug 等）；若 clean 动作失败，应尝试其他候选物品或检查物品是否可清洗。

清洗后放置.title: 目标容器可能已满或不可用
清洗后放置.description: 当目标容器（如 drawer、cabinet、coffeemachine）已满、关闭或不存在时，直接放置会失败。
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: 环境中容器有容量限制或需要先打开；某些目标位置可能没有可用的空位。
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: 在放置前先检查目标容器是否打开且有空位；若目标容器不可用，应寻找替代容器或先清空/打开目标容器。

清洗后放置.title: 物品搜索应优先检查常见位置
清洗后放置.description: 在寻找目标物品时，应优先检查 fridge、countertop、cabinet、drawer、shelf 等常见位置，避免在无关位置浪费步骤。
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: 环境中物品分布有规律，常见位置更可能包含目标物品；盲目搜索会导致步数耗尽或计划失败。
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: 根据物品类型选择优先搜索位置：食物类优先 fridge；餐具类优先 countertop、cabinet、drawer；清洁用品优先 sinkbasin、countertop、shelf。

加热后放置.title: Heat-then-place plan with explicit microwave open/close and heat verification
加热后放置.principle: For heat-then-place goals, decompose into: (1) locate and take the target object, (2) go to microwave, (3) open microwave, (4) put object in microwave, (5) close microwave if open, (6) heat object with microwave, (7) verify the object is hot, (8) take the hot object, (9) go to destination, (10) put the hot object at destination.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: Any task requiring heating an object and then placing it at a destination.

加热后放置.title: Do not attempt to heat an object while it is held; place it in the microwave first
加热后放置.description: Heating actions fail when the object is still in inventory or when the microwave is closed. The object must be placed inside an open microwave before the heat action can succeed.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the object to be inside the appliance and the appliance to be open/closed appropriately before heating.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After taking the object, go to the microwave, open it, put the object in, close it if needed, then heat. Do not call heat while holding the object.

加热后放置.title: Verify the object is hot before taking it to the destination
加热后放置.description: Plans often fail because the heat action did not actually make the object hot, yet the agent proceeds to take and place it. The agent should confirm the object is hot (e.g., via observation or successful heat action) before moving it.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The heat action may fail silently or require multiple attempts; without verification, the agent may place a cold object and fail the goal.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After heating, check the object state or ensure the heat action returned success before taking it. If not hot, repeat the heat action with the object properly placed in the microwave.

加热后放置.title: Avoid unnecessary intermediate placement steps that add extra take/put cycles
加热后放置.description: Some plans include an extra step of placing the heated object on a countertop before moving it to the final destination. This adds unnecessary actions and can cause the plan to fail if the object is not properly tracked.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The planner may over-decompose the task, inserting an intermediate placement that is not required by the goal.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After heating, take the object directly to the final destination and place it there. Do not insert intermediate placements unless required by the environment.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires explicit fridge placement and retrieval
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, after acquiring the target object, explicitly place it in the fridge, then take it back out before moving to the final destination.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires an object to be cooled before being placed in a final location.

冷却后放置.title: Do not skip cooling when the goal requires a cool object
冷却后放置.description: Plans that omit the cooling step and directly place the object in the final location fail to satisfy the goal condition.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The planner may treat the goal as a simple placement task and overlook the required intermediate cooling state.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Always include an explicit cooling step in the plan when the goal specifies a cool object.

冷却后放置.title: Avoid exhaustive search for missing objects
冷却后放置.description: When the target object is not found in the first few likely locations, the planner may enter a long search loop across many cabinets and drawers, wasting steps and failing the task.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The planner lacks a fallback strategy and continues searching without reconsidering the plan or using alternative object sources.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Limit search to a few high-probability locations; if the object is not found, consider whether the goal can be satisfied with a similar object or whether the plan needs to be revised.

冷却后放置.title: Do not assume the target object is already cool
冷却后放置.description: Plans that assume an object taken from the fridge is already cool and skip the explicit cooling step may fail if the object was not actually cooled or if the goal requires a specific cooling action.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The planner may conflate the object's initial location with the required cooled state.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Always perform the cooling action explicitly, even if the object is found in the fridge, unless the goal explicitly allows using an already-cool object.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement
双物品放置.principle: For two-item placement tasks, process one item at a time: locate and take the first item, place it at the target, then locate and take the second item, and place it at the target.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires placing two instances of the same object type at a single target location.

双物品放置.title: Verify target placement before searching for second item
双物品放置.description: In some failed trajectories, the agent attempted to place the first item at the target but the placement did not succeed, yet the agent continued searching for the second item. This led to plan completion without the goal being satisfied.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent may assume a put action succeeded without checking the observation, or may attempt to put an item at a target that is not reachable or not in the current location.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: After each put action, check the observation to confirm the item was placed. If the put action fails, navigate to the target location and retry before proceeding to find the second item.

简单取放.title: Search likely receptacles before opening every drawer
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place tasks, first visit surfaces and open containers that commonly hold the target object, then take the object and place it at the goal location.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.

简单取放.title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
简单取放.principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.

简单取放.title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
简单取放.principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

简单取放.title: Avoid repeated failed navigation to the same unreachable location
简单取放.principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' repeatedly for the same location, stop retrying it and continue searching elsewhere. Repeatedly targeting an unreachable or invalid location can exhaust the step budget and cause plan failure.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务：先定位并携带目标物，再到台灯所在位置使用台灯
台灯观察.principle: 在“台灯观察”任务中，先搜索并取得目标物体，然后前往台灯所在位置，最后使用台灯完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务要求 examine/look at 某物体 with/under the desklamp 时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯是固定物体，不能通过 take 获取
台灯观察.description: desklamp 通常固定在桌面或边桌上，take desklamp 会失败并返回 Nothing happens。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 中台灯属于固定光源，不是可携带物品。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 不要尝试 take desklamp；应前往台灯所在位置并使用 use desklamp 打开它。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务中不要反复 go to 台灯或 desk
台灯观察.description: 在已经位于台灯所在位置后，重复 go to desklamp 或 go to desk 会返回 Nothing happens，浪费步骤。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 台灯不是可导航位置，desk 也可能因已到达而无法再次导航。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 到达台灯所在表面后，直接使用 use desklamp；若需要观察物体，先确保已携带目标物或目标物在台灯附近。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务中不要盲目遍历抽屉
台灯观察.description: 在寻找目标物时，若目标物更可能出现在桌面、边桌、床等表面，不应优先或反复遍历大量抽屉。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 抽屉搜索成本高，且很多台灯观察任务的目标物在开放表面上。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 先检查与台灯相关的桌面、边桌、床头柜等表面；只有在合理位置未找到时才检查抽屉。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place sequence for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-and-place goals, first locate and take the target object, then navigate to a sinkbasin, clean the held object with the sinkbasin, then navigate to the destination receptacle and put the object there.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object in/on a target receptacle and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.title: Open closed destination receptacles before placing
清洗后放置.principle: If the destination receptacle is closed, open it before attempting to put the clean object inside.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the target destination is a closed cabinet, drawer, fridge, microwave, or similar container.

清洗后放置.title: Do not clean non-cleanable objects such as towels
清洗后放置.principle: Some objects, such as towels, cannot be cleaned with a sinkbasin; repeated clean attempts fail and waste steps.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the target object is a towel or another object that does not support the clean action.

清洗后放置.title: Do not assume coffeemachine accepts placed mugs
清洗后放置.principle: A coffeemachine may not be a valid placement receptacle for a clean mug; put attempts can fail even when holding the correct object.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal destination is a coffeemachine and the put action returns no effect.

加热后放置.title: Microwave heating requires holding the object
加热后放置.principle: In ALFWorld, to heat an object with a microwave, the object must be in the agent's inventory when issuing the heat command; placing it inside the microwave and then heating fails.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object using a microwave.
加热后放置.description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.

加热后放置.title: Avoid repeated ineffective heating attempts
加热后放置.principle: If 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' both return 'Nothing happens' while the object is inside the microwave, do not repeat the same commands; instead, take the object out and then heat it while holding it.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When heating an object in a microwave and the first heating attempt fails.
加热后放置.description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.

加热后放置.title: Successful heating and placement sequence
加热后放置.principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, take the object (if needed), heat it while holding it, then go to the target and put it there.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.
加热后放置.description: Successful trajectories follow a consistent pattern: locate the object, pick it up, go to the microwave, open it, ensure the object is held (take it if it was placed inside), issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1', then navigate to the target and 'put <object> in/on <target>'.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: This sequence satisfies the preconditions for heating and placement in ALFWorld.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Not applicable; this is a positive procedure.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and then retrieving it
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, first place the target object into the fridge, then take it out before moving it to the final destination.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and then place it in a cabinet, countertop, microwave, garbagecan, diningtable, sidetable, or coffeemachine.

冷却后放置.title: Do not skip the cooling step by taking an object directly from the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may assume that any object taken from the fridge is already cool, but the task requires the agent to perform the cooling action.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Always put the target object into the fridge before taking it out, even if the object was originally found elsewhere.

冷却后放置.title: Avoid exhaustive cabinet/drawer search when the target object is not found in common locations
冷却后放置.principle: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer; instead, reconsider the object name or task assumptions.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may continue searching all containers, wasting steps and failing to complete the task.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, if the object is still missing, re-examine the goal or consider that the object may not be present in the environment.

冷却后放置.title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms for cooling and placement
冷却后放置.principle: Use 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placing objects and 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieving them; use 'go to <location>' for navigation.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
双物品放置.principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle, place it, then search for and place the second target object.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.

双物品放置.title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
双物品放置.principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

双物品放置.title: Avoid invalid examine action
双物品放置.description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent may attempt to use 'examine' as a way to inspect objects or locations, but the environment only supports navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory actions.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Use 'go to <receptacle>' to navigate to a location and observe its contents, then use 'take <object> from <receptacle>' to pick up items.

双物品放置.title: Open closed containers before placing or retrieving
双物品放置.description: Attempting to put an object into a closed container or take from a closed container results in 'Nothing happens.' The container must be opened first.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires containers to be open before their contents can be accessed or modified.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Before putting an object into a cabinet, drawer, or similar container, ensure it is open by using 'open <container>'. If it is already open, proceed with the put action.

general.title: Locate target before acting
general.principle: For any task, first locate the target object by checking open surfaces and likely locations before attempting to take or manipulate it.
general.when_to_apply: All tasks where the target object's location is not initially known.

general.title: Avoid exhaustive closed-container search before checking open surfaces
general.description: In failed episodes, the planner often searched many closed drawers or cabinets before checking open surfaces where the target object was actually visible. This wastes steps and can lead to plan failure when the object is on an open surface.
general.why_it_happens: The initial plan treats 'find the object' as an unconstrained search and does not prioritize open, directly observable locations over closed containers.
general.how_to_avoid: When locating the target object, first inspect open surfaces and visible locations (tables, dressers, shelves, countertops, sofas, beds, etc.) before opening closed containers. Only open closed containers if the object is not found on any open surface.

general.title: Do not assume target object is absent after failed take attempts
general.description: In failed episodes, the planner repeatedly attempted to take the target object from locations where it was not present, and sometimes concluded the object was unavailable without systematically checking all plausible open surfaces. This led to plan failure even though the object may have been present elsewhere.
general.why_it_happens: The search strategy does not maintain a systematic list of candidate locations and may prematurely stop or repeat failed locations.
general.how_to_avoid: After a failed take attempt, mark that location as checked and move to a new unchecked plausible location. Continue until all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked before declaring the object unavailable.

general.title: Verify action success before proceeding
general.description: Plans often fail because the agent assumes an action succeeded without checking the observation, then proceeds with subsequent steps based on a false state.
general.why_it_happens: The planner may not include verification steps or may ignore failed action feedback.
general.how_to_avoid: After critical actions (take, put, clean, heat, cool), check the observation to confirm success. If the action failed, retry or adjust the plan before continuing.

简单取放.title: Two-step simple pick-and-place plan
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place goals, decompose the task into exactly two ordered subtasks: (S1) find and take the target object, then (S2) put the target object at the specified destination.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the goal is a simple pick-and-place instruction such as 'put a/an/some <object> in/on <destination>' and no additional state change (cleaning, heating, cooling, etc.) is required.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：先定位并点亮台灯，再取目标物
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，先找到并打开 desklamp，再获取待观察物体，最后执行 examine/look。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 目标为 examine/look at X under/with the desklamp，且环境中存在可用的 desklamp。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要先取台灯，除非确认可携带且目标物已就位
台灯观察.description: 多个失败轨迹显示，计划先 take desklamp 会导致后续 take/examine 失败或无法完成观察。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: desklamp 可能不可携带或需要留在原位作为观察光源；先取台灯会破坏后续 examine/look 条件。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 优先在目标物所在位置附近寻找并打开 desklamp；若必须移动目标物，则将目标物带到台灯处，而不是先取走台灯。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：目标物不在初始位置时，先搜索容器再规划取物
台灯观察.description: 多个失败轨迹在未找到目标物时反复开关抽屉或盲目移动，导致 plan_failed。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 目标物可能位于抽屉、柜子等容器中；未系统搜索就尝试取物会失败。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 先按容器类型（drawer/cabinet）系统搜索目标物，找到后再执行 take 和 examine/look。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要用 put 代替 examine/look
台灯观察.description: 部分轨迹将目标物放到 desk 或 desklamp 上，但未执行 examine/look，导致 plan_completed_without_environment_win。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 任务目标是观察，不是放置；put 动作不会触发观察成功条件。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 在目标物与 desklamp 同处后，必须执行 examine X 或 look at X under the desklamp。

清洗后放置.title: 清洗后放置标准三步计划
清洗后放置.principle: 对于“清洗后放置”任务，初始计划应分解为三个有序子任务：S1 找到并拿起目标物品；S2 在 sinkbasin 清洗该物品；S3 将清洗后的物品放到目标容器或表面。
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: 当目标为“put a clean X in/on Y”或“clean some X and put it in/on Y”时。

清洗后放置.title: 清洗前必须确认物品可清洗
清洗后放置.description: 部分物品（如 towel、cloth）在 sinkbasin 上执行 clean 动作时不会成功，导致计划失败。
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: 环境中并非所有物品都支持 clean 动作，或目标物品可能不是任务要求的可清洗物品。
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: 在制定计划时，优先选择常见可清洗物品（如 cup、bowl、plate、knife、pot、pan、kettle、soapbar、lettuce、tomato、potato、egg、dishsponge、ladle、mug 等）；若 clean 动作失败，应尝试其他候选物品或检查物品是否可清洗。

清洗后放置.title: 目标容器可能已满或不可用
清洗后放置.description: 当目标容器（如 drawer、cabinet、coffeemachine）已满、关闭或不存在时，直接放置会失败。
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: 环境中容器有容量限制或需要先打开；某些目标位置可能没有可用的空位。
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: 在放置前先检查目标容器是否打开且有空位；若目标容器不可用，应寻找替代容器或先清空/打开目标容器。

清洗后放置.title: 物品搜索应优先检查常见位置
清洗后放置.description: 在寻找目标物品时，应优先检查 fridge、countertop、cabinet、drawer、shelf 等常见位置，避免在无关位置浪费步骤。
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: 环境中物品分布有规律，常见位置更可能包含目标物品；盲目搜索会导致步数耗尽或计划失败。
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: 根据物品类型选择优先搜索位置：食物类优先 fridge；餐具类优先 countertop、cabinet、drawer；清洁用品优先 sinkbasin、countertop、shelf。

加热后放置.title: Heat-then-place plan with explicit microwave open/close and heat verification
加热后放置.principle: For heat-then-place goals, decompose into: (1) locate and take the target object, (2) go to microwave, (3) open microwave, (4) put object in microwave, (5) close microwave if open, (6) heat object with microwave, (7) verify the object is hot, (8) take the hot object, (9) go to destination, (10) put the hot object at destination.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: Any task requiring heating an object and then placing it at a destination.

加热后放置.title: Do not attempt to heat an object while it is held; place it in the microwave first
加热后放置.description: Heating actions fail when the object is still in inventory or when the microwave is closed. The object must be placed inside an open microwave before the heat action can succeed.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the object to be inside the appliance and the appliance to be open/closed appropriately before heating.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After taking the object, go to the microwave, open it, put the object in, close it if needed, then heat. Do not call heat while holding the object.

加热后放置.title: Verify the object is hot before taking it to the destination
加热后放置.description: Plans often fail because the heat action did not actually make the object hot, yet the agent proceeds to take and place it. The agent should confirm the object is hot (e.g., via observation or successful heat action) before moving it.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The heat action may fail silently or require multiple attempts; without verification, the agent may place a cold object and fail the goal.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After heating, check the object state or ensure the heat action returned success before taking it. If not hot, repeat the heat action with the object properly placed in the microwave.

加热后放置.title: Avoid unnecessary intermediate placement steps that add extra take/put cycles
加热后放置.description: Some plans include an extra step of placing the heated object on a countertop before moving it to the final destination. This adds unnecessary actions and can cause the plan to fail if the object is not properly tracked.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The planner may over-decompose the task, inserting an intermediate placement that is not required by the goal.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After heating, take the object directly to the final destination and place it there. Do not insert intermediate placements unless required by the environment.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires explicit fridge placement and retrieval
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, after acquiring the target object, explicitly place it in the fridge, then take it back out before moving to the final destination.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires an object to be cooled before being placed in a final location.

冷却后放置.title: Do not skip cooling when the goal requires a cool object
冷却后放置.description: Plans that omit the cooling step and directly place the object in the final location fail to satisfy the goal condition.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The planner may treat the goal as a simple placement task and overlook the required intermediate cooling state.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Always include an explicit cooling step in the plan when the goal specifies a cool object.

冷却后放置.title: Avoid exhaustive search for missing objects
冷却后放置.description: When the target object is not found in the first few likely locations, the planner may enter a long search loop across many cabinets and drawers, wasting steps and failing the task.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The planner lacks a fallback strategy and continues searching without reconsidering the plan or using alternative object sources.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Limit search to a few high-probability locations; if the object is not found, consider whether the goal can be satisfied with a similar object or whether the plan needs to be revised.

冷却后放置.title: Do not assume the target object is already cool
冷却后放置.description: Plans that assume an object taken from the fridge is already cool and skip the explicit cooling step may fail if the object was not actually cooled or if the goal requires a specific cooling action.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The planner may conflate the object's initial location with the required cooled state.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Always perform the cooling action explicitly, even if the object is found in the fridge, unless the goal explicitly allows using an already-cool object.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement
双物品放置.principle: For two-item placement tasks, process one item at a time: locate and take the first item, place it at the target, then locate and take the second item, and place it at the target.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires placing two instances of the same object type at a single target location.

双物品放置.title: Verify target placement before searching for second item
双物品放置.description: In some failed trajectories, the agent attempted to place the first item at the target but the placement did not succeed, yet the agent continued searching for the second item. This led to plan completion without the goal being satisfied.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent may assume a put action succeeded without checking the observation, or may attempt to put an item at a target that is not reachable or not in the current location.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: After each put action, check the observation to confirm the item was placed. If the put action fails, navigate to the target location and retry before proceeding to find the second item.

general.title: Search likely receptacles before opening every drawer
general.principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit surfaces and open containers that commonly hold the target object, then take the object and place it at the goal location.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.

general.title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
general.principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
general.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.

general.title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
general.principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

general.title: Avoid repeated failed navigation to the same unreachable location
general.principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' repeatedly for the same location, stop retrying it and continue searching elsewhere. Repeatedly targeting an unreachable or invalid location can exhaust the step budget and cause plan failure.
general.when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

general.title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms
general.principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务：先定位并携带目标物，再到台灯所在位置使用台灯
台灯观察.principle: 在“台灯观察”任务中，先搜索并取得目标物体，然后前往台灯所在位置，最后使用台灯完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务要求 examine/look at 某物体 with/under the desklamp 时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯是固定物体，不能通过 take 获取
台灯观察.description: desklamp 通常固定在桌面或边桌上，take desklamp 会失败并返回 Nothing happens。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 中台灯属于固定光源，不是可携带物品。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 不要尝试 take desklamp；应前往台灯所在位置并使用 use desklamp 打开它。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务中不要反复 go to 台灯或 desk
台灯观察.description: 在已经位于台灯所在位置后，重复 go to desklamp 或 go to desk 会返回 Nothing happens，浪费步骤。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 台灯不是可导航位置，desk 也可能因已到达而无法再次导航。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 到达台灯所在表面后，直接使用 use desklamp；若需要观察物体，先确保已携带目标物或目标物在台灯附近。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察任务中不要盲目遍历抽屉
台灯观察.description: 在寻找目标物时，若目标物更可能出现在桌面、边桌、床等表面，不应优先或反复遍历大量抽屉。
台灯观察.why_it_happens: 抽屉搜索成本高，且很多台灯观察任务的目标物在开放表面上。
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: 先检查与台灯相关的桌面、边桌、床头柜等表面；只有在合理位置未找到时才检查抽屉。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place sequence for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-and-place goals, first locate and take the target object, then navigate to a sinkbasin, clean the held object with the sinkbasin, then navigate to the destination receptacle and put the object there.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object in/on a target receptacle and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.title: Open closed destination receptacles before placing
清洗后放置.principle: If the destination receptacle is closed, open it before attempting to put the clean object inside.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the target destination is a closed cabinet, drawer, fridge, microwave, or similar container.

清洗后放置.title: Do not clean non-cleanable objects such as towels
清洗后放置.principle: Some objects, such as towels, cannot be cleaned with a sinkbasin; repeated clean attempts fail and waste steps.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the target object is a towel or another object that does not support the clean action.

清洗后放置.title: Do not assume coffeemachine accepts placed mugs
清洗后放置.principle: A coffeemachine may not be a valid placement receptacle for a clean mug; put attempts can fail even when holding the correct object.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal destination is a coffeemachine and the put action returns no effect.

加热后放置.title: Microwave heating requires holding the object
加热后放置.principle: In ALFWorld, to heat an object with a microwave, the object must be in the agent's inventory when issuing the heat command; placing it inside the microwave and then heating fails.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object using a microwave.
加热后放置.description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.

加热后放置.title: Avoid repeated ineffective heating attempts
加热后放置.principle: If 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' both return 'Nothing happens' while the object is inside the microwave, do not repeat the same commands; instead, take the object out and then heat it while holding it.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When heating an object in a microwave and the first heating attempt fails.
加热后放置.description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.

加热后放置.title: Successful heating and placement sequence
加热后放置.principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, take the object (if needed), heat it while holding it, then go to the target and put it there.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.
加热后放置.description: Successful trajectories follow a consistent pattern: locate the object, pick it up, go to the microwave, open it, ensure the object is held (take it if it was placed inside), issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1', then navigate to the target and 'put <object> in/on <target>'.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: This sequence satisfies the preconditions for heating and placement in ALFWorld.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Not applicable; this is a positive procedure.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and then retrieving it
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, first place the target object into the fridge, then take it out before moving it to the final destination.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and then place it in a cabinet, countertop, microwave, garbagecan, diningtable, sidetable, or coffeemachine.

冷却后放置.title: Do not skip the cooling step by taking an object directly from the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may assume that any object taken from the fridge is already cool, but the task requires the agent to perform the cooling action.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Always put the target object into the fridge before taking it out, even if the object was originally found elsewhere.
冷却后放置.description: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.

冷却后放置.title: Avoid exhaustive cabinet/drawer search when the target object is not found in common locations
冷却后放置.principle: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer; instead, reconsider the object name or task assumptions.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may continue searching all containers, wasting steps and failing to complete the task.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, if the object is still missing, re-examine the goal or consider that the object may not be present in the environment.
冷却后放置.description: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer; instead, reconsider the object name or task assumptions.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
双物品放置.principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle, place it, then search for and place the second target object.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.

双物品放置.title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
双物品放置.principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

双物品放置.title: Avoid invalid examine action
双物品放置.description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent may attempt to use 'examine' as a way to inspect objects or locations, but the environment only supports navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory actions.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Use 'go to <receptacle>' to navigate to a location and observe its contents, then use 'take <object> from <receptacle>' to pick up items.

双物品放置.title: Open closed containers before placing or retrieving
双物品放置.description: Attempting to put an object into a closed container or take from a closed container results in 'Nothing happens.' The container must be opened first.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires containers to be open before their contents can be accessed or modified.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Before putting an object into a cabinet, drawer, or similar container, ensure it is open by using 'open <container>'. If it is already open, proceed with the put action.
